headline: KAPPO derives adaptive policy pressure for pass@k and max@k post-training
summary: The authors derive closed-form optimal policies for KL-regularized pass@k and max@k objectives and identify prompt-adaptive pressure that can be implemented by modifying standard @1 optimization. They report experiments on mathematical reasoning and code generation using OLMo-3-7B-Instruct-SFT and Qwen3-4B-Base: KAPPO variants reduce the paper's measured sharpening pattern, and @k-A*PO using one new completion per prompt is reported comparable to PKPO, which requires at least k on-policy completions. These are paper-reported results, not independent reproductions.
